title: Word Formation: Festivals and Traditions (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj ponizszy tekst. Uzupelnij kazda luke (1.1-1.8), przeksztalcajac wyraz podany w ramce w taka forme, ktora logicznie i gramatycznie pasuje do kontekstu. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych wyrazow. Dwa wyrazy zostaly podane dodatkowo i nie pasuja do zadnej luki.
tasks.text: Festivals play an important part in the life of almost every culture around the world. 1.1. _________, many of them began as ways of marking the changing seasons or a successful harvest. Special dishes, 1.4. _________ eaten only on these days, are prepared in enormous quantities. Stories, songs and recipes are carefully passed down through the 1.5. _________. The highlight of many events is a 1.6. _________ display of fireworks that lights up the night sky. In some cities, thousands of 1.7. _________ take part in a single parade. 1.8. _________, even in our busy modern world, many of these ancient customs continue to thrive.
